title: Scout Motors starts validation builds at $2B SC plant, deliveries in 2028

That’s two years later than the 2026 production start the company was talking about before it even broke ground on its $2 billion factory. more…

title: Tesla needs wireless charging fast, or its $30,000 Cybercab can’t charge at home
summary: Tesla is now taking orders for the $29,990 Cybercab, with the first deliveries expected in Austin next month. But there’s a problem buyers should know about: they won’t be able to charge it at home. The Cybercab has no onboard charger, so it only takes DC fast charging. And the wireless home charging pad Tesla has been teasing since 2023 still isn’t something you can buy. more…

title: Tesla unveils 7.4 MW Powercore to take on ex-exec Baglino’s Heron Link
summary: Tesla has unveiled Powercore, a solid-state medium-voltage transformer that also handles the inverter and breaker functions in a single unit. Tesla rates it at 7.4 MW (9 MVA) continuously at 34.5 kV, with grid-forming support up to 10 MVA of peak power. It’s made in America and scheduled to start operating in 2027. That’s the same year Heron Power, the startup founded by Tesla’s former top engineer Drew Baglino, plans to start volume production of its own solid-state transformer, the Heron Link. more…
